title: Interleaving String
summary: Decide whether s3 can be formed by taking all characters from s1 and s2 while preserving the order from each source.

contractDetails.constraints: s1 and s2 have lengths 0–100. s3 has length 0–200. All characters are lowercase English letters.

statement: Decide whether s3 can be formed by taking all characters from s1 and s2 while preserving the order from each source.

examples.explanation: The first source would need to produce b before a.

constraints: s1 and s2 have lengths 0–100. s3 has length 0–200. All characters are lowercase English letters.
hints: Conceptual: Check the total length first.
Directional: A state says how many characters each source has supplied.
Implementation: Accept a state if either preceding state was reachable and its next character matches s3.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn + m + n) time and O(n) space.
